hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy. It coordinates token distributions: deploying initializer contracts that run a token auction, then migrating raised funds and reserved token amounts into v4 liquidity positions at a price derived from the auction's final price. The `beforeInitialize` permission is used to gate pool creation to the strategy itself only.
